races.name: QuinnBet Second To The Favourite "Hands And Heels" Apprentice Handicap (Part Of Racing Excellence)

runners_data.name: Divine Wish
runners_data.comment: C&D fourth in January, in a maiden not run to suit, reads well enough; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: All four starts have come over 7f on the AW and she has shown ability, as when fourth of 12 on handicap debut at Kempton last month; still unexposed and respected if showing similar form on turf.

runners_data.name: Cooramook
runners_data.comment: Often runs well here but not yet off the mark and others more likely for the win
runners_data.spotlight: 0-18; has made the frame on several occasions, but 7f on a straight track like this may just stretch her.

runners_data.name: Heretic
runners_data.spotlight: First 27 starts came on the AW (three wins) and was making his turf debut when third of 13 at Doncaster (7f, good to soft) last month (fourth has won twice since); 5lb below last winning mark and much respected for stable that won this in 2024.

runners_data.name: Rusheen Boy
runners_data.comment: Has won on turf but four of his five wins have been on AW.
runners_data.spotlight: Four of his five wins have come over 6f/7f on the AW, but the other came in emphatic fashion here (6f, good to firm) a year ago; probably ran even better than it looked when third of ten at Lingfield (7f, good) last month and a major player for last year's winning stable.

runners_data.name: Bear To Dream
runners_data.comment: Six-time winner; off since 2nd here on AW in January; won't want ground softer than good
runners_data.spotlight: A bit in and out since winning narrowly from 2lb lower at Chepstow (7f, good) last July; could do with the ground drying out.

runners_data.name: Sedgemoor
runners_data.comment: Two AW wins this year and placed at Haydock last time; respected back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Dual 6f winner on the AW this year, but does have winning form on turf; needs to put a poor effort at Doncaster last month (7f, good to soft) behind him, though, and probably wouldn't want rain.

runners_data.name: My Boy Jack
runners_data.comment: All three wins at Wolverhampton over 6f; below his best when last seen and headgear is off
runners_data.spotlight: Has won fresh so the 107-day absence not the end of the world, but a record of 0-23 on turf and 3-84 overall shows that he is usually worth taking on; non-runner.

races.name: Paul Corrigan Memorial Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Nevasca Cinza
runners_data.comment: Sets the standard on what he's shown in three races and should have a lot more to offer
runners_data.spotlight: In the frame in all four starts over 6f, but was sent off odds-on when only third of six here (good) last time; doesn't appear to be progressing, but is still shortlisted on form and cheekpieces are now given a go.

runners_data.name: Upper Hendersyde
runners_data.comment: 220,000gns yearling; dam a maiden from a good sprinting family; betting to guide
runners_data.spotlight: 220,000gns yearling; 9-2 when second of 12 on his Salisbury debut (6f, good) last month; not sure how stong the form is with the third horse finishing a well beaten third of four at Leicester on Monday, but he is open to improvement.

runners_data.name: Rogue Federation
runners_data.spotlight: 40,000euros foal; 45,000gns yearling; half-brother to five winners including Summer Daydream (6f including 2yo Listed/AW; RPR 96), Cityzen Serg (8.6f AW; 91), Initial Blue (6f AW including 2yo; 76) and Summer Lady (Italian 7f-1m1f); dam placed 6f-7f (including 2yo/AW; 78); already gelded but worth monitoring in the market.

runners_data.name: Yazoo
runners_data.spotlight: £50,000 yearling; dam 5f/6f AW winner (including 2yo; RPR 103), closely related to 1m Listed winner Zurigha, half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Lily's Angel, out of unraced half-sister to French 10.5f Group 3 winner In Clover; already gelded but his pedigree makes him well worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Anyasi
runners_data.spotlight: 150,000gns yearling; sent off 14-1 when beaten 6l into third of six behind the subsequent Greenham winner Alparslan on his Leicester debut (7f, good to firm) last August, showing signs of inexperience; the form has also been franked by those behind as well so he has to be taken seriously on his return.

runners_data.name: Court Alert
runners_data.comment: 2nd in 6f Newmarket sales race last August is the best form in this, easily his best too
runners_data.spotlight: Looked a winner waiting to happen when second of 20 in a sales race at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last August, but heavy defeats in both outings since need forgiving (gelded before latest start); has undergone wind surgery since last seen.

runners_data.name: Debrief
runners_data.comment: Well-beaten fourth of six on his Yarmouth debut in October; major improvement required
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000gns foal; well held in two novices (6f/7f) seven months apart; handicaps over further may be more suitable after this.

runners_data.name: Red Legs
runners_data.comment: First foal; probably best watched on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Missed the break and took a keen hold when eighth of ten on her Windsor debut (6f, good to firm; 40-1) ten days ago; may need more time.

runners_data.name: George Wickham
runners_data.spotlight: Ran green when last of seven on his Bath debut (5.7f, firm; 12-1) last August; major improvement required.

runners_data.name: Unique Procedure
runners_data.comment: Beaten about 12l at Nottingham ten days ago (6f, good) when a 100-1 chance
runners_data.spotlight: Huge prices and well beaten in two starts over 6f on good ground in April, the latest here (hooded both times); best watched for now.

races.name: Winning Experience With Moulton Racing Handicap

runners_data.name: Existent
runners_data.spotlight: Finally ended a 49-race losing run at Southwell (5f, AW) in January; now 2lb lower than for that success and this company is much easier than that he normally keeps, but his record of 1-47 on turf still makes him hard to warm to.

runners_data.name: Thunder Star
runners_data.comment: Has won five times on turf; failed to beat a rival at Yarmouth latest; switch of headgear
runners_data.spotlight: All five wins have come over 5f on turf and was only beaten a head at Thirsk (5f, good) six days ago; 1lb well in and won't mind what the weather does; major player.

runners_data.name: Al Barez
runners_data.comment: 7yo who is not easy to predict and his last win was in April 2024; down the list
runners_data.spotlight: Losing run up to 15, but has been running well in defeat as when beaten less than a length into third of ten at Windsor (5f, good) last month; races off the same mark, but he is another for whom this trip looks sharp enough.

runners_data.name: Neyva's Angel
runners_data.comment: One place behind Fantasy Master last time; looked unlucky and could well gain her revenge
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Southwell (6f, AW) in April and was only beaten a head here (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago with a yawning gap back to the rest; 4lb rise not the end of the world and good to soft ground wouldn't be a problem, but another furlong may have been preferable.

runners_data.name: Travel Agent
runners_data.comment: Quickly clicked into gear for this yard with eyeshield on; solid second latest; feared
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins have come over 6f on the AW including two in April; handles turf, but he has a fair bit to find with Neyva's Angel on their meeting here (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; he too may be better over further.

runners_data.name: Prefer The Sister
runners_data.spotlight: 1-24, the win coming at Kempton  (7f, AW) at the end of 2024; makes her stable debut after 101 days off having changed hands for 2,200gns in April; not sure what to expect on only her second go over a trip this short.

runners_data.name: Chasing Gold
runners_data.comment: Reared as the stalls opened on turf comeback and unseated; can only be considered risky
runners_data.spotlight: Has made the frame seven times, but now 0-14 and is virtually reappearing from six months off having unseated his rider exiting the stalls at Nottingham last month; that wasn't the first time he has had issues at the start so is probably best watched; blinkers given a go.

runners_data.name: Mighty Ruler
runners_data.comment: 1-19; ran well over 6f last time and this step back up in trip will suit; 0-4 on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from 20 starts came off this mark at Lingfield (7f, AW) in January; turf form not so hot including a fall at Lingfield last month; others more persuasive.

runners_data.name: Court Of Session
runners_data.comment: Opened his account on turf when winning at Nottingham last week; respected under a penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time AW winner who was getting off the mark on turf at the 16th attempt when successful at Nottingham (6f, good) eight days ago; however, he was well beaten over this C&D (soft) yesterday.

runners_data.name: Walking On Clouds
runners_data.comment: Slid to a competitive mark for his current yard; one to consider back in headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Last 23 starts have come on the AW and he is 4lb well in under a penalty for his emphatic success in refitted blinkers at Lingfield (6f) ten days ago; he has won twice on turf, though, so the change in surface shouldn't be an issue; major player.

runners_data.name: Coolagh Magic
runners_data.comment: 0-21 on grass but has become dangerously well handicapped on the pick of his turf form
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who is 9-46 on the AW, but 0-22 on turf while his losing run is up to 16 despite a plummeting mark; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Top Star
runners_data.comment: Longstanding maiden who missed a chunk of his career; tried without headgear today
runners_data.spotlight: Finished 8l behind Walking On Clouds at Lingfield (6f, AW) ten days ago, taking his record to 0-14; only 4lb better off and has finished out of the frame in all five starts on turf; tongue-tie needs to make a big difference.

runners_data.name: Mr Phillips
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7, though he ended last term with much his best performance when third of 16 over C&D (good to soft; 125-1) in October; off eight months since, but would hold each-way claims if picking up where he left off; stable also runs Tilsworth Turf.

runners_data.name: Tilsworth Turf
runners_data.comment: Both wins over 6f on soft ground but he's mostly struggled since the latest of those
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins came over 6f on soft ground in 2024, but he's mostly struggled at big odds since the latest of them; best watched for now.

runners_data.name: Moonrunner
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in his first three starts, beaten a length on turf debut in a Haydock maiden (11.6f, soft) three weeks ago; could well continue to improve now handicapping and one to take seriously.

runners_data.name: First Officer
runners_data.comment: Ran well off this mark when last seen but he's done most of his winning in small fields
runners_data.spotlight: Goes on any ground; didn't run at all badly when fifth of ten at Salisbury (1m4f, good) 19 days ago having been off for eight months (has run well fresh); now 1lb below his last winning mark and considered.

runners_data.name: Patrol
runners_data.comment: AW second last time was his best effort for a while but he's not the percentage call
runners_data.spotlight: 3-13 on the AW and 0-12 on turf, though he was only beaten half a length by Yokohama at Newbury (1m4f, good) last month (third has won since); 4lb rise for that does make things a bit harder, though.

runners_data.name: Newtown Duke
runners_data.comment: Off since narrow 1m AW win in November but middle distances on turf seem okay
runners_data.spotlight: 1-2 on the AW and 0-9 on turf, though in the frame seven times as when third of 15 in a Chester apprentice handicap (1m4f, good) on his reappearance last month; a couple of those in behind have won since and he makes the shortlist.

runners_data.name: High Point
runners_data.comment: Latest start was comfortably his best show on AW but he needs to find extra
runners_data.spotlight: Back off the same mark as when successful at Haydock (1m6f, good to soft) last September; Flat form since has been patchy but still one for the shortlist, especially if the ground stays on the soft side.

runners_data.name: Baltic
runners_data.comment: 307 days off; new trip on first run since changing hands and leaving Harry Charlton
runners_data.spotlight: Five-timer for the Charlton stable between September 2023 and July 2024 included a win over C&D, but he was beaten out of sight on his stable debut/reappearance at Kempton 15 days ago; has plenty to prove now.

runners_data.name: Yokohama
runners_data.comment: 1m2f record is far more appealing than his two runs at 1m4f, and his turf tally is 0-11
runners_data.spotlight: Was winning for the first time since his debut when just getting the better of Patrol at Newbury (1m4f, good) last month; 5lb higher and could probably do with the ground drying out (best form on good or faster), but still respected.

runners_data.name: Fox Avatar
runners_data.comment: New mark demands more but he could find the requisite improvement now he's turned five
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 1m2f/1m4f on the AW last summer and probably needed his Kempton reappearance 15 days ago having been off for nine months; won on turf as a 3yo and worth considering back in a Class 4.

races.name: Download The QuinnBet App Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Zafaan
runners_data.comment: Dual Flat winner; placed in 5 of his 7 races over hurdles; interesting with Sean Bowen on
runners_data.spotlight: 2-28, his latest success coming in a similar contest over C&D (good) just under a year ago; a player if producing his best form.

runners_data.name: Sunset In Paris
runners_data.spotlight: All six wins have come at around this trip on the AW; moderate effort over hurdles last month and withdrawn in that code subsequently having been unruly at the post; best watched.

runners_data.name: Dors Delight
runners_data.spotlight: 1-17 on the AW, the win coming in a similar contest to this at Chelmsford (1m2f) last August; hard to know how she will cope on her belated turf debut, though.

runners_data.name: Wingstar
runners_data.comment: Tailed off at Naas on debut only previous run on turf; no promise on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who showed a little ability on the AW at the start of the year, but her two efforts for this yard leave plenty to be desired.

runners_data.name: Sporty Socks
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was twice placed on the AW last year, but well held in all five starts on turf, the latest over C&D last month; drop in grade needs to make a difference.

runners_data.name: Trackman
runners_data.comment: 0-23 on the Flat, having had several chances off basement marks; hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-24 under rules, but has made the frame three times in eight visits here; could sneak into the frame again.

runners_data.name: Churchill's Spirit
runners_data.spotlight: Well held in three starts over 7f on turf/AW late last year; off six months, but this trip is more in line with his pedigree and worth a second look in the first-time tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Wrist Art
runners_data.comment: Hasn't won since 2023 and never been this far; again runs from 6lb out of the handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins came in Ireland in the autumn of 2023; not beaten far in his last two starts in 0-70 handicaps at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) and Southwell (1m3f, AW) and even if those efforts flatter him, they still make impressive reading at this level.

runners_data.name: Sweetstevie
runners_data.comment: Never the slightest threat at long odds in two runs over 1m; hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Big prices and has finished out the back in three starts at Southwell (1m, AW) early this year; switch to turf and first-time visor need to make a dramatic difference.

runners_data.name: Sapphire Dream
runners_data.comment: Fair fifth from 5lb out of the weights here (1m) on latest but tough draw to overcome
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced in ten starts over 5f-1m on turf/AW in Ireland; makes his stable debut after 132 days off having been picked up for 1,000gns in February; drops in class, but still needs more.

runners_data.name: Rockafeller Skank
runners_data.comment: Finished last in three runs last autumn; gelded since
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival in three starts over 7f last autumn; having been gelded, he reappeared in a 1m classified here (soft) yesterday and won with something to spare, also shaping as though he would be suited by today's extra distance; has to be respected under 6lb penalty if running again.

runners_data.name: Bennyworth
runners_data.comment: Five starts on AW, finishing second of six at Lingfield in April; up in trip on turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort when second of six on handicap debut at Lingfield (1m, AW) in April, but he didn't get home on turf debut there (1m2f, good to firm) ten days ago, which is a worry stepping up again in trip; stable also runs Darkest Red.

runners_data.name: Salamis Bay
runners_data.comment: Non runner
runners_data.spotlight: Some ability in her first two starts over 6f on the AW and faced an impossible task at Ascot (1m2f, good; 125-1) last month; still open to improvement on handicap debut and may show a bit more.

runners_data.name: Premier Cru
runners_data.comment: Has regressive results but may stage a turnaround now handicapping
runners_data.spotlight: Has regressed in her four starts and finished miles behind Tenison at Nottingham (1m2f, good to soft) last month; needs a turnaround.

runners_data.name: Home Secretary
runners_data.spotlight: Beat a total of one rival in four starts over 7f/1m on turf/AW last autumn; gelded since and makes his handicap debut in first-time cheekpieces after 227 days off; market should be revealing.

runners_data.name: Tenison
runners_data.comment: Far from solid on form and has something to prove off her opening mark
runners_data.spotlight: Appeared to improve when fourth of 11 on handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f, good to soft) last month, but still finished over 10l behind the winner; further improvement needed, but stepping up again in trip may help.

runners_data.name: Darkest Red
runners_data.comment: Bit unlucky not to go closer latest (Keep It Classic behind) and is on the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Gradually getting there, beaten under a length here (1m2f, good) in April and going down by a short head in a 14-runner event at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) last month, finishing nicely clear of the rest; up 4lb, but still looks the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Queen Of Astolat
runners_data.comment: Beaten 14l+ in all three starts; bred to improve for this trip on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed a bit more when sixth of ten on handicap debut at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) last month; more needed, but she may come on for that first start in 135 days.

runners_data.name: Cospicua
runners_data.spotlight: 2-4 in AW handicaps with both wins coming over 1m4f at Kempton, but she was well beaten in the other two; not quite sure what to expect on turf debut, but she is the only previous winner in the field.

runners_data.name: Picaro
runners_data.comment: Took a step forward when 4th at Southwell but others have more substance to their claims
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort in three starts when fourth of eight in a Southwell novice (1m3f, AW) in April; could show more now handicapping with cheekpieces applied.
